rationale: GDS gapped down 6.5% at the open and has since bounced from the session low of $18.72 to $20.13, placing price at 58% of today's range and well above VWAP ($19.42) and the 9-EMA ($19.81). The stock is in a no-man's land — too far off the low for a clean long entry with a tight stop, yet showing upward momentum that makes a short risky. The wide bid-ask spread (39.7 bps) and the elevated VIXY reading add friction and uncertainty, making the risk/reward unattractive in either direction at this moment.
